task: Vyhľadajte v internetovom obchode ľubovoľnú knihu od Franka Herberta a vložte ju do košíka. Potom vyhľadajte ďalšiu knihu (ktora nemusi byt od Franka Herberta) z sekcie sci-fi a tú tiež vložte do košíka. Nakoniec otvorte košík.

goalSpec.goal: Search for a Frank Herbert book, add it to the cart, search for another sci-fi book, add that to the cart, and then open the cart.
successCriteria: A book by Frank Herbert is added to the cart.
An additional sci-fi book is added to the cart.
assumptions: Books can be added to the cart.
constraints: Both books must be available for purchase.

subtasks.doneWhen: The cart reflects the addition of the sci-fi book.

subtasks.title: Open the cart
subtasks.doneWhen: The cart page is displayed with both books.

stopReason: LLM completion check confirmed task completion despite missing strict deterministic evidence.
finalVerdict: Do košíka bola pridaná kniha "Dreamer of Dune: The Biography of Frank Herbert" za cenu 20,85 € a kolekcia kníh DUNA za 141,55 €. Celková cena v košíku je 162,40 €. Môžete prejsť do pokladne alebo sa vrátiť do obchodu.
